name: Due Diligence
description: Comprehensive due diligence report for evaluating a company across financial, legal, operational, and strategic dimensions

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.purpose: High-level summary of the due diligence findings including overall assessment, key risks identified, notable strengths, and a clear recommendation with supporting rationale.

sections.title: Company Overview
sections.purpose: Provide a comprehensive overview of the target company including history, mission, business model, products/services, organizational structure, key locations, and employee count.

sections.title: Financial Health
sections.purpose: Analyze the company's financial position including revenue trends, profitability, cash flow, burn rate, debt obligations, and key financial ratios. Identify any financial red flags.

sections.title: Leadership & Team
sections.purpose: Profile the leadership team and key personnel including backgrounds, track records, tenure, and any concerns. Assess organizational depth, culture signals, and employee retention data.

sections.title: Legal & Compliance
sections.purpose: Review legal standing including corporate structure, pending or past litigation, regulatory compliance status, licenses and permits, and any known legal risks or liabilities.

sections.title: Market Position
sections.purpose: Assess the company's position within its market including market share, competitive advantages, customer base, brand perception, and growth trajectory relative to the market.

sections.title: Technology & IP
sections.purpose: Evaluate the company's technology stack, intellectual property portfolio (patents, trademarks, trade secrets), technical debt, scalability of systems, and any proprietary technology advantages.

sections.title: Risks & Red Flags
sections.purpose: Consolidate all identified risks and red flags across financial, legal, operational, and strategic dimensions. Categorize by severity (critical, high, medium, low) and likelihood of impact.

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.purpose: Provide a clear, evidence-based recommendation (proceed, proceed with conditions, or do not proceed) with a summary of the key factors driving the decision and suggested next steps.

sections.title: Sources
sections.purpose: List all sources consulted during due diligence including public filings, databases, news articles, interviews conducted, and third-party reports with dates and credibility assessments.
